meta.defaultDescription: NesilCoffee produces premium coffee, with roasting and quality control at every stage. Wholesale B2B supply.

hero.title: Roasting, flavor and quality control at every stage
hero.subtitle: A smile, pure enjoyment and a boost of energy — all in a single cup of our coffee

products.description: A well-balanced 100% Arabica coffee with a smooth yet distinctive profile. A medium roast brings out creamy and nutty notes for a rich flavor, while the low acidity leaves a smooth finish.

office.title: The perfect format for the home and office
office.body1: Premium 3-in-1 instant coffee in a 20-serving pack — a convenient choice for everyday use.
office.body2: This size is ideal for large families, workplace teams and businesses, while individual sachets make storage and preparation simple.

searched.title: The coffee you have been looking for
searched.body1: We carefully select our coffee beans to preserve their natural character and flavor.
searched.body2: Gentle roasting reveals the unique flavors and aromas of each variety while preserving its individual character. Our aim is to create coffee that expresses the quality, origin and character of every bean.

capacity.title: Modern production facilities
capacity.body1: Our factory is equipped with modern roasting and packaging lines designed to process substantial volumes of green coffee, with a particular focus on the specialty and premium segments.
capacity.body2: Our facilities can accommodate a wide range of roast profiles — from light and delicate roasts for specialty coffee to rich, deep roasts for espresso blends. We have deliberately designed our production so that scale never comes at the expense of precision and every batch meets strict quality standards.

organic.title: 100% organic product
organic.body1: Our products begin with organic green coffee grown without artificial additives or harsh processing methods. We are committed to clean ingredients and full transparency about their origin.
organic.body2: This organic approach makes the product suitable for regular consumption and helps preserve coffee's natural qualities with minimal intervention.

italian.title: Italian roasting and a balanced flavor
italian.body1: Our coffee is roasted to Italian standards, with close attention to flavor balance and the careful development of each bean. This approach prevents excessive bitterness, preserves a clean flavor profile and creates an approachable, enjoyable cup.
italian.body2: Italian roasting works equally well for whole-bean coffee and instant formats, delivering an approachable, enjoyable flavor for everyday drinking.

certified.title: Certified production
certified.body1: Our production processes comply with the international ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000:2018 standards, confirming a systematic, well-structured approach to quality management and food safety at every stage.
certified.body2: Our additional Halal certification reflects our sense of responsibility throughout production and makes the product suitable and accessible to a broad audience.

hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: The story, standards and team behind NesilCoffee.

welcome.title: Welcome to NesilCoffee
welcome.sideTitle: Created with passion, perfected with care
welcome.sideBody: Sourced from more than 15 countries, NesilCoffee's 100% organic beans tell the story of nature at its finest.

geography.title: From the misty highlands of Ethiopia to the sun-drenched slopes of Colombia
geography.body1: Every bean is hand-picked on chemical-free plantations surrounded by breathtaking scenery.
geography.body2: Roasted with Italian craftsmanship and certified organic, NesilCoffee weaves Guatemala's smoky depth, Indonesia's earthy chocolate and Rwanda's floral notes into a rich cup made with care for the environment.
geography.body3: Against a backdrop of majestic mountains, NesilCoffee offers a symphony of flavor, with respect for nature expressed in every sip.

step1.title: Raw material selection
step1.body: NesilCoffee quality is built at every stage — from selecting raw materials to dispatching the finished product. We work exclusively with pre-selected materials: green coffee beans and ingredients for 3-in-1 drinks, chosen from the outset in line with NesilCoffee's approved specifications and recipes.

step2.title: Development and testing
step2.body: Before production begins, every raw material is checked for quality and condition to confirm that it meets our specifications and is ready for use. Our in-house product development and quality control team creates and expands the range: our specialists develop recipes, refine the balance of flavor and aroma, test products and approve their composition to ensure consistent quality and a recognizable taste in every item.

step3.title: Quality control
step3.body: During production and before dispatch, every finished product undergoes a final inspection. We check the quality of roasting and blending, the integrity of the packaging, the accuracy of the labeling and compliance with established standards. Only after its quality has been confirmed is the product released to the warehouse and our customers.

experts.title: Our experts share the principles and production approach behind their work

one.quote: “Every bean, every roast profile and every pack reflects the care, technology and experience of the NesilCoffee team. This is how we create coffee that we are proud to offer our customers.”

two.name: Bayramguly Gurbangulyev
two.role: Head of Quality Control and Product Development
two.quote: “NesilCoffee represents a thoughtful approach to the quality of every product. We carefully monitor every stage of production to guarantee consistent flavor and high standards in every batch.”

idea.title: The idea
idea.body:
The idea for NesilCoffee grew from a love of authentic coffee and a desire to create a brand that brings together quality, flavor and a modern outlook. We wanted to create more than just coffee: a product that would become part of everyday moments, from the first cup in the morning to a warm gathering with loved ones or a business conversation.

The name Nesil means “generation” and reflects our central idea: to create coffee that brings generations together and passes the culture of enjoying authentic coffee from one generation to the next. We believe that good coffee is more than a drink. It is a mood, an emotion, a tradition and a special moment worth sharing.

NesilCoffee is our story of coffee created with respect for tradition and an eye to the future.

search.title: The search
search.body: We searched for the finest suppliers of green coffee beans and world-class equipment to build a production facility that meets international quality standards.

roast.title: Roasting
roast.body: Our technologists developed signature roast profiles that reveal the finest notes of every origin — from light Scandinavian roasts to dark Italian roasts.

launch.title: The launch
launch.body: The first batches of NesilCoffee were delivered to our partners — from major retail chains to HoReCa businesses and corporate customers — winning over markets across Central Asia.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a:
The minimum order quantity depends on the product category and delivery format.

For wholesale orders, minimum quantities are determined by cost-effective logistics and the type of packaging. We are happy to discuss smaller starter or trial batches with new partners.

items.q: Do you only accept wholesale orders?
items.a:
Yes, NesilCoffee operates as a B2B company and focuses on wholesale supply.

We work with distributors, regional dealers, retail chains, HoReCa businesses, corporate customers and international export partners, providing a reliable supply and a flexible approach to every partner's needs.

Products are supplied under FCA (Free Carrier) terms and collected from the manufacturer's warehouse.

Once an order is ready, the buyer or their authorized carrier collects the products from our warehouse. We ensure that the shipment is fully prepared for dispatch, including packaging, labeling and a complete set of accompanying documents.

If required, we can also recommend reliable logistics partners to arrange transportation to the destination.
Deferred payment is not available. Orders require 100% advance payment.

items.q: Can I request a price list?
items.a:
Yes, our current price list is available on request.

Please contact our sales team and specify the products and quantities you are interested in, along with the destination country. We will prepare a tailored commercial offer for you.
